children: ChainPort shuts down its cross-chain bridge on 01 Dec 2026. The shutdown removes a route for moving USDC between Chiliz Chain and other chains through ChainPort.

The bridge is ChainPort's main service, and closing it weakens the investment case for PORTX. Users who still have funds in the bridge's smart contracts when it closes may not be able to recover them.
1/5 🚨 IMPORTANT: Action required for USDC holders on CHILIZ® Chain.
ChainPort is shutting down on 1 December 2026.
If you hold USDC on CHILIZ® Chain, please bridge your funds to a supported destination network as soon as possible, while liquidity remains available.

title: Chiliz: ChainPort shuts down its cross-chain bridge - 01 Dec 2026
